_comment: Run boons (RunState.gd): after each boss win you pick 1 of offer_count. They last until the expedition ends. Effects: break_heal (party heals this share of max HP when you Break an enemy), link_gain_mult (x), reveal_weaknesses (true), enemy_break_delta / hero_break_delta (+/- hits to Break), wave_heal (HP/MP share restored at each wave's start), start_link (+Link each battle), gold_mult (x wave gold), guard_pips (+attacker pips on Perfect Guard).

vigor.name: Vigor
vigor.description: Breaking an enemy heals your party 8% of max HP.

steadfast.name: Steadfast
steadfast.description: Your heroes take one more hit to Break.

second_wind.name: Second Wind
second_wind.description: Recover 10% HP and MP at the start of every wave.

bulwark.name: Bulwark
bulwark.description: Perfect Guards stagger the attacker twice as hard.
